microtheory.name: meaning_as_vector
microtheory.definition: Meaning is not a scalar. A word or utterance carries a WEIGHTED SET of coexisting readings — a vector / superposition — and rich text sustains several at once, often on purpose. Understanding KEEPS the set and models the relations among its components; it collapses to one reading only under task pressure, never by default. This corrects the disposition of the earlier faculties (believe/role/resolve), which Argmax to a single meaning and discard the vector.

concepts.name: meaning_vector
concepts.definition: The meaning of a form is a WEIGHTED SET of readings (a vector), not one resolved sense. Keep the whole set; do not Argmax it away. Collapse to a single reading only when a task demands one, and even then retain the alternatives as live. The substrate already supports this (a Mention can carry many refers_to; a word can carry many provenanced Claims) — the change is to STOP collapsing.

concepts.name: semantic_tension
concepts.definition: Two readings of one form held in OPPOSITION — opposite valence or contradiction — both live at once. This is the structure UNDER irony, sarcasm, and contronyms (wicked = evil AND excellent): the meaning IS the tension between the poles, not either pole. Recognised when the vector contains both a positive and a negative reading with real weight.

concepts.name: co_activation
concepts.definition: Two or more DISTINCT readings of one form both active and compatible — a pun or double-entendre (bank = riverside AND financial): both senses are meant, neither is the error. Recognised when the vector holds two+ readings each above a liveness weight, not in opposition.

concepts.name: aboutness
concepts.definition: A reading whose referent is itself another reading / utterance / trope — the recursive (order-N) component of the vector: meta-commentary, lampshading, allusion. Meaning composed over meaning, representable as a reading-edge whose target is itself a reading node, applied recursively.

concepts.name: authored_multiplicity
concepts.definition: Divergence of readings that is INTENTIONAL — richness to be kept (the pun, the irony, the layered allusion) — versus accidental ambiguity, to be flagged or resolved from context. Telling these apart is part of understanding: keep the authored multiplicity, do not flatten it.
